applies_to: Johnson Controls Premier 25-50 ton R-410A packaged rooftop units (MZVAV or SZVAV) with the Applied Smart Equipment controller.
summary: The Premier 25-50 ton rooftop units use the Applied Smart Equipment controller, which has BACnet MS/TP (plus Modbus and N2) on its FC bus and BACnet IP through an optional plug-in card. The points list is all AV, MV and CSV objects in the 29501-30079 range: occupancy and unit enable commands, heating and cooling setpoints, network override inputs for zone and outdoor sensors, unit, fan, cooling and heating status, refrigerant circuit values, runtimes and fault flags. Many points belong to options and stay unused on units without them.
notes: Taken from Table 32 (BACnet Points List) of the 25-50 ton Premier start-up and operation guide; the table has only AV, MV and CSV objects.
Multistate states are printed from 0 in the table. BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the device may report the printed number + 1; check the state text on discovery.
Enable polarity is not consistent: FanOnOcc and C1A-En/C1B-En/C2A-En print 0 = YES, 1 = NO, while C2B-En and most other enables print 0 = NO, 1 = YES.
The last six rows (MVCritical, MVServicePriority and MVService Active/Inactive Event, instances 29995-30000) give object type "0" and no description; they are listed here as type Other.
Points for heat stages 4-8, the second circuit, exhaust, energy recovery wheel, HGRH, humidification and UV lights only carry data on units with those options.
Writable setpoint ranges from the table are in the descriptions.

source.title: Premier Rooftop Units 25-50 Tons Start-Up & Operation Guide

integration.summary: Pick the field bus mode (BACnet MS/TP on the FC bus, or BACnet IP with the optional card) and set the device OID in Controller > Network. Set OccMode (MV 29518) to External so the BAS occupancy request on NetOcc (MV 29520) is used, keep UnitEn (MV 29896) at Enable, and write the occupied heating and cooling setpoints. Read Unit-S, Fan-S, the zone temperature in use and DAT for status.

minimum_points.name: NetOcc
minimum_points.why: BAS occupancy: occupied, unoccupied or not set

minimum_points.name: OccMode
minimum_points.why: Must be External for BAS occupancy

minimum_points.name: Unit-S
minimum_points.why: Unit state: idle, SD alarm, purge, start-up wizard

minimum_points.name: Fan-S
minimum_points.why: Fan state: off/idle, on/purge, on/valve or limit fault, on

minimum_points.name: DownInOccAlm
minimum_points.why: Unit down during occupied mode (1 = alarm)

integration.enable: UnitEn (MV 29896) enables or shuts down the unit; the default is Enable. With OccMode (MV 29518) at Schedule the unit follows its internal schedule. With OccMode at External, an occupied command from the BAS (NetOcc, MV 29520), a zone sensor override or the hard-wired occupancy input makes the unit occupied.
integration.heartbeat: No unit-level heartbeat point is listed. A zone temperature written by the BAS times out after 15 minutes without an update; the controller then falls back to a NetSensor, the wired zone sensor, then return air temperature.
integration.remote_sensors: Write zone temperature to NetZT (AV 29526), setpoint offset to NetSSO (AV 29540), zone humidity to NetSH (AV 29533), indoor CO2 to NetIAQ (AV 29530), and outdoor air temperature, humidity and CO2 to NetOAT, NetOAH and NetOAQ. A BAS zone temperature has top priority over local sensors. ZTSrc, IAQSrc, SHSrc and OATSrc show which source is in use.
setup: BACnet MS/TP: set FCBusMode to Wired Field Bus; default MAC address 4 (range 4-255), default baud 38400.
BACnet IP needs the optional BACnet IP card; with it installed, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus and N2 on the FC bus do not work. Choose DHCP or a static IP, mask and router in Controller > Network.
Device OID range 0-4194302, set from the local display or a MAP gateway; it is also writable as DeviceId (AV 29897).
FC bus cable: 22 AWG 3-wire twisted shielded; set the EOL switch ON at each end of a bus segment. Use Cat 5/5e/6 for BACnet IP.
SZVAV must be enabled at commissioning (SZVAVEn); MZVAV is the default unit type.
gotchas: Multistate values in the table start at 0; confirm the numbering on the device before writing NetOcc, OccMode or UnitEn.
NetOcc only acts when OccMode is External.
DctShutdownSp (AV 29567) is a high duct static limit; exceeding it locks the unit out as a critical fault. ResetLO (MV 29826) resets lockouts.
Unit name, serial number and device name are writable CSVs; do not write them cyclically.
